pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels; t = frame/24

camera.view: top-down (bird's-eye) looking straight down at a plain uniform grey floor; finite distance -> mild perspective: elevated parts (heads) appear displaced radially away from the image centre (~960,540), e.g. walker's head sits right of shirt centre when at x~1700, centred at x~1060
camera.scale_uniformity: bicycle length 416-418 px at x~1650 vs 408 px at x~250 (~2% change across the frame): slight tilt or lens effect; treat one scale as adequate (~1-2% error)
camera.note: frames 0 and 1 show identical object positions (differences are only codec noise; repeated first frame) -> zero apparent motion between frames 0 and 1

cyclist.description: person in black jacket, dark hair, riding a light-cyan (turquoise) bicycle with rear rack; lower object (rides along y~648)

parts.bicycle: cyan frame, front wheel to the LEFT (direction of travel), rear rack on the right
parts.rider: black jacket, seated near bike centre, hands on handlebar

cyclist.direction: -x (right to left), straight line along y = 648-649 (bike axis)
cyclist.reference_point: bike_center_x/bike_center_y = midpoint of front and rear cyan tips (vehicle root proxy); rider_torso_x/y = centroid of dark (jacket+hair) blob, ~ pelvis/saddle proxy, sits ~28 px behind (right of) bike centre
cyclist.pixel_motion: constant velocity: bike centre moves -51.3 px/frame (least-squares over frames 1-40, max residual 3 px; per-frame diffs 50-52 in frames 1-32, quantisation +-1). x(f) ~ 1826.0 - 51.3*(f-1) for f>=1; no motion between frames 0 and 1

walker.description: man in white/light-grey T-shirt, blue-grey jeans, black sneakers, dark hair, walking; upper object (head at y~429-438)
walker.direction: -x (right to left), roughly straight along y~433 (head), lateral sway +-4 px with 34-frame period
walker.reference_point: head_x/head_y = centroid of hair blob (best-tracked, ~above pelvis; radial perspective offset of the head vs pelvis up to ~10-25 px near frame edges). shirt_x/y and mask_cx/cy also given
walker.pixel_motion: head x from ~1912 (f0/f1, extrapolated) / 1897.4 (f2) to 904.0 (f71): mean -14.4 px/frame, per-frame -12.4 to -16.9 (gait oscillation, 17-frame step period)

static_objects: none: plain uniform grey floor without markings; only soft contact shadows under both people

events.event: video start; both already moving left; cyclist rear and walker's right side cut by right edge
same object positions as frame 0 (repeated first frame)
bicycle fully in frame (rear tip x=1879)
last frame with bicycle fully in frame (front tip x=34)
bicycle front reaches left edge, starts exiting
last frame with any of the cyclist visible (rear tip x=31)

events.note: no contact, collision, start or stop: both move at steady pace throughout; no direction changes; the two never overlap (y separation ~215 px between bike axis and walker head)
